# Online Bar

> Online Bar is an online store for drinks, snacks, and gifts. Customers must be 18 or older. Product availability, delivery eligibility, and fees are confirmed in the live store and checkout.

## Pages
- [Shop](https://www.onlinebar.co.ke/shop): browse the live catalog.
- [Delivery areas and fees](https://www.onlinebar.co.ke/delivery): current mapped delivery areas and configured fees.
- [Build the Night](https://www.onlinebar.co.ke/build-the-night): start a house party drinks plan using the live catalog.
- [Event drinks planning](https://www.onlinebar.co.ke/concierge): event-planning information.
- [Party drinks planning guide](https://www.onlinebar.co.ke/guides/how-much-alcohol-for-a-party): plan around guest preferences, event details and alcohol-free options.
- [Shipping and delivery information](https://www.onlinebar.co.ke/shipping)
- [About Online Bar](https://www.onlinebar.co.ke/about)
- [Contact](https://www.onlinebar.co.ke/contact)
- [Returns](https://www.onlinebar.co.ke/returns)
- [Privacy](https://www.onlinebar.co.ke/privacy)
- [Terms](https://www.onlinebar.co.ke/terms)
- [Sitemap](https://www.onlinebar.co.ke/sitemap.xml)

Online ordering is open 24/7. Delivery locations listed in the directory:
- Nairobi County: CBD, Westlands, Kilimani, Lavington, Kileleshwa, Karen, Langata, South C, South B, Embakasi, Roysambu, Kasarani, Kahawa, Githurai, Zimmerman, Utawala, Mombasa Road.
- Machakos County: Syokimau.
- Kajiado County: Kitengela, Rongai (Ongata Rongai), Ngong.
- Kiambu County: Kikuyu, Thika Road (Thika).
- Mombasa County: Nyali, Mombasa Island.
- Kisumu County: Kisumu CBD, Milimani.
- Uasin Gishu County: Eldoret CBD.
- Nakuru County: Nakuru CBD.
- Trans Nzoia County: Kitale CBD.

Eligible local Nairobi deliveries are estimated at 10–30 minutes from order placement, subject to exact address and availability; this estimate does not apply to every listed location. Checkout confirms delivery coverage, option, fees, and current ETA. Upcountry shipping follows separate courier timelines. Prices, stock, and fees may change. The sitemap includes the delivery directory; individual neighborhood pages are not published without verified local service details.

Customer care is available online 24/7 and replies within 15 minutes. Contact support by WhatsApp or phone at +254 769 345 599, by email at support@onlinebar.co.ke, or on the [contact page](https://www.onlinebar.co.ke/contact).
